thread:
incidents-bot: ALERT: Pager triggered — SLO breach: inference.p99 = 3.2s over last 5m; streaming stalls observed; control-plane errors (auth timeouts, config-fetch 5xx). Affected: prod-hosted, prod-dedicated-us-east. Routing: eng-runtime + eng-sre paged.

Alex: ack. I'm on it, joining.

Priya (eng-sre): seeing auth-db 504s in the tail, repeated 100ms->800ms retries; controlplane rate limit spiked to ~120k rps.

Alex: quick numbers: p95 = 780ms, p99 = 3.2s, streaming socket errors from 0.2% -> 4.8% in the last 5m. Lots of long-lived sessions hit stalls.

Jun (eng-runtime): traces show config-fetch for featureflags adding ~800ms on cache miss; some requests do 2-3 retries.

Lisa (eng-platform): featureflags endpoint returning 429s from ff-store; redis connection pool at 95% used, evictions up.

Mateo: any deploys or config changes in last 30m to controlplane/ff?

Priya: no user-facing deploys in last 30m. Autoscaler for ff-store started spinning replicas then upstream DB started throttling.

Alex: immediate mitigation plan:
- enable local config cache on runtime (ttl=30s)
- bump internal control-plane token buckets temporarily
- scale ff-store read replicas and enable read-side caching
- route streaming-heavy sessions to fallback model variant redwood-compact-v1
- enable chunked streaming flush (smaller writes)

Priya: toggling local config cache now.

ops-bot: deploy triggered by Priya: config-cache-toggle=true (sha: b7f8c3) — rollout 10% -> 100% in 30s.

Alex: starting fallback for streaming routes to compact model (percent-based rollout).

Jun: enabling chunked flush with chunk_size=256 to reduce single-write stalls.

Lisa: DB team scaled read pool x2; added read-only replicas. Redis evictions decreasing.

Alex: metrics update (~2m post-mitigation): p95 -> 430ms, p99 -> 1.1s; streaming error-rate -> 0.6%. Still seeing rare auth tail spikes (~1/min).

Mateo: customer impact summary: CS reports 2 customers (acme-corp, beta-client) observed stalled streams and UI refreshes from 10:12–10:22. No message loss; degraded UX only.

Priya: monitoring 15m window. Oncall handoff to Mateo in 30m.

Mateo: will take handoff and own postmortem. Adding runbook notes.

Alex: short-term postmortem notes:
- suspected root cause: ff-store DB overload -> 429s -> config-fetch latency -> runtime retries -> increased tail latency for inference path
- mitigations applied: local cache toggle, fallback model routing, chunked streaming, scale read replicas
- follow-ups: add circuit-breaker on config fetch, backpressure between FF and DB, increase redis capacity, tune token-buckets, add targeted alerting for ff-store 429s

Priya: severity: sev3 (SLO breach, limited customer impact). Assigning postmortem owner: Mateo.

Mateo: creating postmortem draft and will link timeline + mitigation steps. Will also coordinate customer comms with @customer-success.

customer-success-bot: CS acknowledged — outreach will go to affected accounts with timeline and workarounds.

Alex: closing active mitigation. Monitoring for 60m. Rule: if p99 > 1.5s reopen pager.

ops-bot: Incident status -> mitigated, monitoring. Closing pager.
